About Us

Celebrations shaped with purpose and heart.

Trusted catering and event experiences from the cultural heart of Kerala.

PRIDE KITCHEN CATERERS & EVENTS

Turning meaningful moments into lasting memories since 2008.

From flavour and hospitality to decor and seamless execution, we bring every element together with care. Our work is guided by one simple belief: every celebration should feel personal, effortless, and unforgettable.

Our Story

Rooted in tradition. Refined through experience.

Our journey began in Thrissur with a passion for exceptional cuisine and genuine hospitality. What started as a focused catering service has grown into a complete event partner trusted by families, businesses, and communities across Kerala.

18+Years of creating memorable celebrations
Our Evolution

One team for every detail of your celebration.

Today, we unite catering, venue planning, decor, entertainment, and event coordination under one thoughtful approach. Modern standards meet Kerala's rich cultural character to create experiences that feel polished, warm, and distinctly yours.

Our Promise

A signature built on trust.

We listen closely, plan carefully, and deliver with consistency. Our greatest achievement is the confidence clients place in us to make their most meaningful days feel effortless.

Faces Behind the Brand

The people who carry every celebration with care.

Managing Director

Rijo George

Rijo guides the strategic growth and operational excellence of the organisation, ensuring every project reflects the company's standards of quality, reliability, and attentive service.

Founder & CEO

General Manager

Our Leadership Philosophy

Where passion and teamwork create perfection.

Together, we continue to build lasting relationships and create extraordinary experiences for families, businesses, and communities across Kerala.
